title: Part Variant Attributes
description: Defines one variant of a vehicle part: its model, textures, animations, tags and sub-parts. A part definition either holds a single variant written inline or a map of named variants.

tags.description: Part tags, used for connector matching (required_tags / acceptable_tags / forbidden_tags of the opposite connector) and functional classification.

model.description: Model path. Leading folders are ignored: machine_max:ae86_chassis.geo matches ae86_chassis.geo.json anywhere under models/ in the content pack.

oneOf.description: Single texture, registered under the name "default". For example "machine_max:textures/part/ae86/ae86_armor.png" becomes the part's "default" texture.
Map of texture name to image path. The first entry is the texture the part starts with, by convention named "default"; another entry is selected by name, e.g. by a spray can.

textures.description: Texture configuration. The part fails to load when the resulting texture map is empty.

animations.description: Animation path. Leading folders are ignored: machine_max:ae86 matches every animation json under animations/ in the content pack whose folder is named ae86, and exposes them as available animations of the model.

oneOf.description: Single sub-part, registered under the default name "sub_part.machine_max.main".
Map of sub-part name to sub-part configuration.

sub_parts.description: Sub-part definition. A sub-part is the smallest unit of part movement, so every movable part of the model is a sub-part.
